text: Compactor bin on Elm Street keeps jamming; please tally how many bulky items are sitting in the hopper in the latest snapshot and send back just the figure. Offsite processing on your servers is fine, ordinary accuracy will do, and this can go in the regular queue since nobody is waiting on it.

hey, can you count the rags snagged on the intake screen at the pump station and ping me the total? keep the footage on the station's own box, it can't leave the plant. it needs to be spot-on accuracy wise, but honestly no hurry, whenever it comes up is fine

The Provider shall extract the characters displayed on the particulate monitor panel in Operating Theatre 4 from each photograph submitted by the Client and return them as machine-readable text. The Client consents to such photographs being transmitted to, and processed at, the Provider's external data centre.

Sawmill infeed notice: the stamped ID on the latest log end is unreadable to the grader. Please transcribe the lettering from the attached still, keeping the image on the mill's own server with nothing sent offsite. Flagged as priority, process immediately.

Hey assistant, find every car and cyclist waiting at the Fifth and Main junction and mark where each one is with a box. Keep that video on the roadside cabinet, don't send it anywhere else. It's routine, so no need to bump it up the line.

Hi Priya, Could you have the system count how many inverters in the row C cabinet photos are showing an amber fault LED, and reply with only the total? You're welcome to run it on the hosted cloud service rather than at the farm. A regular model is perfectly adequate, and there's no time pressure, so slot it into the usual rotation. Thanks, Marco
Lane 3 scanner captured a crate manifest label; please pull the printed consignment details off that image as text. Baseline accuracy is acceptable for this one.

yo, how many flare stacks on the platform are actually burning in this morning's images? number only pls. needs the sharpest model you've got, no sloppy guesses, but it's not time sensitive at all, it can take the usual turn

For each frame captured at the north-stand turnstiles, the Vendor shall identify every person and carried bag present and supply rectangular coordinates delimiting each. Processing may be carried out on the Vendor's off-premises infrastructure. Results shall meet the top accuracy grade offered under this agreement. Requests under this clause carry routine priority and are not to be expedited.

Pump Station 12 update: the motor nameplate photo from today's walkdown needs its serial and rating text transcribed. Processing is restricted to the station's edge unit, and the image may not leave the facility.

Okay, tally the lightning-strike marks on blade two from the drone pass and just tell me how many. The footage stays at the wind farm, so process it on the turbine-side computer. This is a routine job, not a rush.

Subject: truss count for bay 6. Hi team, please count the ripe tomato trusses visible in the bay 6 canopy images and send back a single figure, nothing else. The photos can go to your cloud platform for this, and there's no need for the premium model. I do need it prioritised, though, because the harvest crew is being scheduled this afternoon.

Toll gantry on the M4 eastbound flagged a plate it couldn't read; transcribe the registration characters from the captured frame. This feeds a billing dispute, so use the most precise recognition available, and please push it to the front of the queue.

mate, can you read off what's printed on the fan controller display in the tunnel photo I just sent? keep the pic on the tunnel's local box, it's not allowed off-site. and pls jump on it right away, the vent crew's waiting

Under Schedule B, the Contractor shall determine how many strain gauges in the main-cable anchorage images display a fault indicator and report that total as a single integer. Conventional-grade analysis is acceptable for this purpose. Such requests are routine and shall be handled in ordinary queue order without expediting.
Runway 16R debris cam: an object near the threshold bears printed markings. Transcribe any legible lettering in the attached still using maximum-accuracy recognition. No escalation needed.

Hey, look at the view from the lamp post on Harbour Road and put a box around each parked scooter you spot. Process it on the pole's own unit, nothing goes off it. The everyday model is fine for this.

Hi Jonas, The welding cell's arm keeps misplacing brackets, and I need every bracket in the attached fixture images located and outlined with box coordinates. Go ahead and run it on the off-site GPU cluster. Please treat this as top priority, because the line is stopped until we know. Cheers, Ana
Chairlift gate at the base station: need a headcount of skiers queued in the latest overhead frame, reported as one figure only. The frame can be shipped to the central resort server for processing.

hey, the thermal cam at Riverside substation caught the label on a transformer bushing, can you pull the text off it for me? fine to send it up to the cloud. don't need anything fancy accuracy-wise, but I need it asap, outage call in 20 min

The Service Provider shall convert the stencilled stand and compartment codes appearing in images from the harvester cab into text. Images may be uploaded to, and processed on, infrastructure outside the harvesting area. These requests shall be serviced at routine priority; no expedited handling is required.

Van 14 cargo alert, rear door opened mid-route: locate each pallet and carton in the compartment snapshot and return box coordinates. Cloud processing permitted, basic accuracy acceptable. Marked priority, handle first.
Assistant, how many workers at the site gate right now aren't wearing a hard hat? Give me the number and nothing more, and make it snappy, I need it before the crane lift starts.

Hello Sam, Attached is a photo of the handwritten gravity log taped to fermenter 5; could you have it transcribed into text for me? This one needs to jump the queue, since we're deciding on the dry hop this morning. Thanks, Lee
Summit gondola turnstile: locate every ski pass held up to the reader in today's clips and outline each with a box. Clips must be processed on the lift station's edge server and stay on the mountain.
can someone find where each meerkat is in the enclosure feed and draw boxes round them? needs to be dead accurate, the vet's checking for the missing pup, so please bump it to the top of the pile

The Supplier shall, for every image captured at the debarker infeed, identify each log and visible knot defect and provide the rectangular region enclosing it. The Purchaser authorises transfer of these images to the Supplier's remote facility for analysis. Such work is classified as non-expedited and shall follow the regular processing schedule.
FOD sweep result, taxiway Bravo: please mark each piece of debris in the latest frame with a bounding box. Use the most accurate detector you have. Can wait for the usual cycle.

Hey, count the salmon near the surface in pen four's underwater feed and just say the number. Run it on the barge computer, the footage can't leave the farm. Use the best model you've got, and do it right now, the feed boat is about to dump.

Hi Dana, The dashboard photo from haul truck HT-207 shows a fault code on the display that we need captured as text. Feel free to process the image on the corporate cloud instead of the pit's edge node. Regards, Tom

X-ray lane flagged an irregular pallet: find each concealed package in the scan image and return a box for every one. Offsite analysis at the central lab is permitted. Escalate, officers are holding the truck.
hey, from the cabin cam on bus 12's morning run, how many kids got on? just the number, and a basic model will do the job

The Provider shall count the totes resting on each AGV's deck as shown in submitted images and return solely the resulting integer. Images may be processed in the Provider's cloud region outside the warehouse. All such requests shall be treated as priority work and executed ahead of the ordinary queue.
Milking stall 6: tally the cows waiting in the holding pen from the latest snapshot and report a single number.
Read me the container ID painted on the box hanging from crane two, keep the footage on the quay's local server, and use your most precise text reader.

Dear operations, Please locate each passenger and wheelchair on the gangway in the attached boarding images and supply bounding box coordinates. Processing on your hosted service is acceptable. Mid-tier accuracy is sufficient for this review. Kind regards, Terminal Office

Ward 7B bedside cam: need each IV pole and drip bag in the room image boxed with coordinates. Patient images are to be processed only within the hospital, not sent out. Default model accuracy is adequate.
hey can you pull the writing off the seed-bag labels in the drone shots from the north paddock? gotta be really exact, one wrong digit messes up the order, but no rush, whenever

The Contractor shall transcribe into text the setpoint values printed on the climate controller's screen as captured in photographs from Greenhouse Block C. Transmission of these photographs to off-premises processing systems is permitted. Each request under this clause shall be expedited and processed ahead of all non-priority work.
AGV-09 docking: shelf label at bay 41 unreadable by onboard scanner. Transcribe the label text from the uploaded photo with top-accuracy recognition. Not time-critical, queue in the usual order.
Read the destination code on the tag of that bag circling carousel five, basic accuracy's fine, and hurry, the passenger's connection leaves in ten minutes.

Hi Grace, The thermal imager at Northgate substation captured the rating plate on transformer T2, and I'd like its text extracted. The image must be processed on the substation's local gateway and never leave the yard. Please use the most exacting recognition option available, as these values go into our asset register. Best, Ravi

Intersection at King and George: box every pedestrian in the crosswalk footage, with coordinates for each. Video is to be analysed on the roadside controller and stay put there. Top-grade precision required, and it can go through the usual queue without any rush.

how many cracked sleepers did the track scanner pick up on the Up line near the depot? only need the count. keep the scan data on the depot server, it can't go off site, and middle-of-the-road accuracy is plenty

The Operator shall determine the number of vehicles passing beneath the toll gantry in each submitted interval of footage and report that value alone. All footage shall be processed within the gantry's roadside equipment and shall not be transmitted beyond it.
Spreader lock event on Berth 3: capture the container's painted owner code and seal number as text from the attached frame. Remote cloud processing is authorised. Premium-accuracy OCR required.

Show me where the bags and strollers are near the platform screen doors on the southbound side, with a box on each one. It's fine to send the clip to the central server, and the regular detector is good enough.
Hello Mei, For the Grade A filling line, could you locate each contaminant particle visible in the attached settle-plate microscope images and mark it with a bounding box? Many thanks, Oliver

Charge nurse on the respiratory ward is asking how many bedside monitors show an alarm light in the attached photo; send back one figure. Basic accuracy is acceptable. Treat as priority, she needs it immediately.
hey, can you find each out-of-place item on aisle 9's shelf scan and put boxes around them? cloud's fine for processing, a run-of-the-mill model is fine too, and there's no rush on this one

The Service Provider shall render as text the figures displayed on the rain gauge and anemometer readout in photographs taken at the Block 4 weather station. Such photographs shall be processed exclusively on the vineyard's own equipment and shall not leave the property. Commercially reasonable accuracy is acceptable, and requests shall be handled in routine order without expedition.

Locker bank at Central Station reports an obstruction: locate every parcel and foreign object in the compartment image and return a box for each. Processing may be done on the remote cloud. Maximum detection accuracy required.
Count the people gathered under the lamp post at the park entrance and give me the headcount and nothing else, use your most accurate model, and I need it right this second.

Hi Kofi, The gauge photo from valve station 22 shows the pressure dial and its stamped tag, and I need both read off as text. Keep the image on the station's edge box; it cannot leave the site. Average accuracy is acceptable, but please expedite, since we're deciding on a shutdown within the hour. Thanks, Irene
Charging hub, bays 1 to 8: mark each parked vehicle and any charging cable lying on the ground with a box in the overnight image. Everyday-grade detection is fine and this can wait its turn.
how many cereal boxes are left on the top shelf in the scan from aisle 4? I only need the figure, but it has to be bang on, we're reconciling stock against it

The Provider shall count the distinct hotspots visible in each thermal frame from the Ridgeline lookout tower and report only that count. Frames shall be processed solely on the tower's local compute unit and shall not be transmitted elsewhere. Moderate accuracy is acceptable for this function. Every request under this clause shall be accorded precedence over all other queued work.

Flare stack alert, platform Delta: locate each visible flame front and smoke plume in the latest frame and outline them with boxes. Process only on the platform's edge server, nothing sent ashore. Precision must be top tier, and this is flagged priority, handle now.

How many oil drips are on the tray under the main engine in this morning's engine-room clip? A bare number is all I want. Keep it on the ship's onboard computer, and give me your most careful count, though it's no rush.

Hello Priyanka, Could you locate every worker and light vehicle within the haul truck's blind zone in the attached rear-view stills and supply box coordinates for each? This feeds our collision review, so the analysis needs the most accurate detector on offer. It is not time-critical; the usual turnaround works. Regards, Ben
